'''Koba Prime''' was the [[Star/Legends|sun]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Koboth]]. It scorched Koboth with [[Solar flare/Legends|solar flares]], as well as Koboth's three [[Moon/Legends|moons]].
